notes.title: 10 years of game development! 🎉
notes.content:
Guess what? I've been an independent game developer for 10 years now! 🤯

When I left EA Chillingo at the end of 2014, I was just eager to make my own games… I never for a minute imagined I’d still be here 10 years later with my own little business! 😊

My first released game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/549860/One_Night_Stand/?curator_clanid=43313223]One Night Stand[/url], was made during Nanoreno Game Jam, and it exploded in popularity and kinda took over my life!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43313223/9d953034b85f0bdd6e19dccad706d117a541413b.png[/img]

When things settled down, I realised my previous project I was working on would require a larger team to create the vision I had for it. So I started working on the semi-autobiographical ‘Memories’ while continuing to work on One Night Stand localisations, console port and physical edition.

However, in 2019, my personal circumstances changed. I became disabled and struggled to work at the same pace I did before. Then 2020 happened, and Memories didn’t feel like the right game to be putting out in the world anymore. My life and everyone else’s was changing, so I wanted to make something more hopeful (and bittersweet)… In came [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2079180/VIDEOVERSE/?curator_clanid=43313223]VIDEOVERSE[/url]!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43313223/c987a39660f9f04c20594178f7b95672a8eb4924.jpg[/img]

After three years development, VIDEOVERSE launched on August 7th 2023 to critical acclaim. I never expected the reviews to be as glowing as they were and it seemed like switching my focus in 2020 was the right call.

Sometimes, I feel sorry for my unreleased projects…but One Night Stand and VIDEOVERSE wouldn’t have existed without them. And hey, I haven’t fully given up on finishing them either, but indie development is certainly more competitive now than it was 10 years ago, so – for the time being – I’m focussing on smaller, more manageable projects! 💪

[b][h1]What's next for Kinmoku?[/h1][/b]
Entering 2025, I’m continuing support on VIDEOVERSE (including a Japanese localisation) and already far along with my 👀 next project 👀 ! The story is written, in-engine and even features character and background art...but there is still a lot to do! However, this next project will be smaller than VIDEOVERSE, so I’m hoping to release before the end of the year. The tricky part now…is coming up with a title!

To stay updated with my games, please follow me here or consider subscribing to my newsletter on [url=https://www.kinmoku.games ]www.kinmoku.games[/url] 

Thank you for reading and best wishes for the new year!

notes.title: Celebrate the first 'VIDEOVERSARY' with a new drawing update!
notes.content:
On [b]August 7[/b], it will have been one year since VIDEOVERSE launched on PC, Mac and Linux! Can you believe it? So much has happened in this year!

Firstly, VIDEOVERSE remains 'Very Positive' on Steam, with 90 on Metacritic and 92 on OpenCritic, which made it one of 2023’s highest-rated games! It also won 'Best Narrative' at Debug Indie Game Awards and 'Critics’ Choice Award' at Indie Cup UK, and was nominated for several other awards, including 'Safe in our World Award for Mental Health', 'Everyone Can Award for Accessibility' and 'Best Hidden Gem'. In such a competitive year, this was an incredible achievement for such a small indie game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/4710a99faf1fbeef3ae7bc593a71f7384c9cbdfb.png[/img]

So, to celebrate the first...[i]VIDEOVERSARY[/i], please enjoy [b]30% off[/b] during the PixElated Festival (July 29 - August 5) and the brand new Drawing Update (1.2), which contains the following features:

[h2]Gallery[/h2]
Now, you can collect all the drawings across Videoverse, plus CGs and cut-scenes! Please note: You'll need to start a new game to unlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/943b44ccca6149abdb43ab52c5de8941cf1c7a80.png[/img]

[h2]Drawing Opportunities[/h2]
There are more opportunities to draw throughout the game via the Art Corner community. It's completely optional (for the artists amongst us!) but feel free to share your creations in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2079180]Steam community[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/8b49a47469c153a723581d1275354ec3316bfbda.png[/img]

[h2]Art and GUI Polish[/h2]
Artwork across the game has been polished, plus GUI has been improved in areas for smoother controller play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/04b33286a18466b171bba37a8501f59bb990740e.png[/img]

[h2]Faster Messages[/h2]
Due to popular demand, a new option ‘Faster Messages’ has been added in the Preferences menu. This speeds up private chat messages and is recommended for repeat play-throughs and achievement hunters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/e1ae5658dc71ec5663728e69fb1baa126c2ef461.png[/img]

Thank you all again for the continued support over the last year. VIDEOVERSE's community maybe small but it's the sweetest out there! I hope you enjoy the new update and are able to collect all the drawings...and please share your own drawings in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2079180]Steam community[/url]!

[h3][i]"Bye eMMe-T_T. Good luck with your drawings. :)"[/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/ecd8e686098d5765e7de4cdcc2cf905ee4dc7ac9.png[/img]

notes.title: VIDEOVERSE wins Best Narrative at Debug Indie Game Awards!
notes.content:
Last week, VIDEOVERSE won "Best Narrative" at the first Debug Indie Game Awards in Nottingham, UK! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/662fe7af4a9e601e1efc5de2eda6964f34a4b7d3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/bd8a6570edc8910030f5f9787d424a92a8843043.png[/img]

A huge thank you to the fans, play-testers, players who've reported bugs (seriously, you guys are such a help!) and, of course, those who voted for it! It warms my heart seeing VIDEOVERSE get recognised for its narrative amongst so many brilliant games that released in 2023.

VIDEOVERSE was also nominated for "Safe In Our World Award for Mental Health" and "Everyone Can Award for Accessibility" and, although it didn't win, just being nominated meant so much. VIDEOVERSE was a game I made to help me through a dark time and I really wanted it to do the same for others, while making it as accessible as possible so more people could experience it. I'm inspired to keep pushing for these efforts in future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/292ecd8cea530f28d9c59d53c91a6c908ec03878.jpg[/img]

There's also been an update today (1.1.2.0), which contains sprite improvements, smiley fixes and a bug fix at the end of chapter 1. Please download to enjoy...and thanks again to everyone for your continued supported!

notes.title: Happy Holidays from Kinmoku!
notes.content:
It’s that time of year again for the Steam Winter Sale – Enjoy 20% off VIDEOVERSE until January 4th 2024...its biggest discount yet! If you’ve already played it, why not gift it to a friend this holiday season? [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/2e35702ed67ba8dca8aa04282c15ffa64a4b74bf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/67a52eb039b245991dafad79d5dae9d69d23e977.gif[/img]

Also on sale, is my first game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/549860/One_Night_Stand/?curator_clanid=43313223]One Night Stand[/url]. For those of you that missed it, One Night Stand is a short narrative game where you are thrust into an awkward one night stand scenario. It’s shorter than VIDEOVERSE but with more branching options and 12 different endings. If you enjoyed the animations and conversations in VIDEOVERSE, I think you’ll really like One Night Stand, too!

In other news, VIDEOVERSE has appeared in a few more GOTY lists, on [url=https://www.digitaltrends.com/gaming/best-10-indie-games-2023/?utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=socialorg&utm_campaign=rss-feed]Digital Trends[/url], [url=https://sassygamers.com/goty-2023-10-6/]SassyGamers[/url] and [url=https://www.stuff.tv/features/best-indie-games-of-2023-the-biggest-hits-from-small-studios/]Stuff[/url], in addition to some personal lists and podcast recommendations. I'm so happy to see people sharing their love of the game with others...mostly via word-of-mouth and print magazines, which is fascinating for a game about online connections! I think it's because the game is set in 2003... "It was the style at the time" after all! XD

Thanks again for supporting me and VIDEOVERSE this year. I wish you all the best for 2024!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/1158c8f56cfbbaaebd90d3d2b29fec92ae75113f.png[/img]

notes.title: VIDEOVERSE Steam Deck compatibility is here!
notes.content:
I’m happy to announce that VIDEOVERSE is now running smoothly on Steam Deck! Please update your game to 1.1.0.0 to enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/ac157e3daddab784e9b0b59f49afc18fb89de285.jpg[/img]

To celebrate, there is a 10% discount until 20th October (3 AM PDT / 12 PM CEST)! As Steam is still learning about VIDEOVERSE, there is no official badge yet, but hopefully that will change soon… For now, this update allows you to control the game using the button controls, touch screen or on-screen cursor. Check out the official VIDEOVERSE controls when you load up the game on your Steam Deck for more info.

In-game controls can be found here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/e8abec9bb5af5d307b8265b96a8c3c9592badf0d.png[/img]

For regular desktop users, this update also contains some UI redesigns, alternate main menu music and message arrival bug fixes. 1.1.0.0 has also been updated to use the latest Ren’Py 7 engine.

Thank you so much for waiting patiently for Steam Deck compatibility these last two months. I originally thought 1.1.0.0 would only take a few weeks to complete, but Ren’Py doesn’t typically use controllers as the default input, hence there were a lot of obstacles and compromises to get here. I hope you enjoy this update and thanks again for your continued support of VIDEOVERSE!

notes.title: The VIDEOVERSE Original Soundtrack has landed!
notes.content:
It's been one month since [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2079180/VIDEOVERSE/]VIDEOVERSE[/url] launched on Steam! To celebrate, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2562740/VIDEOVERSE_Original_Soundtrack/]VIDEOVERSE Original Soundtrack[/url] is now available to download. Now, you can immerse yourself in the chill soundscape of the Kinmoku Shark, composed by Clark Aboud ([i]Slay the Spire, Kind Words[/i]) and relive the days of your favourite retro gaming consoles!

The soundtrack features 14 tracks, plus bonus startup sounds for the Kinmoku Shark and Kinmoku Dolphin by Alexandre Carvalho. Both MP3 and WAV formats are included.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/ff448dc08dfa2dc6d0c572a14b18a4123d96121c.png[/img]

This album artwork features a [i]certain someone's[/i] Kinmoku Shark setup – Can you guess whose?

The latest version of VIDEOVERSE (1.0.1.0) includes this scene as a new, optional menu background. When you complete the game, it will unlock, and the button "Change Background" will appear at the bottom of the menu if you wish to revert back to the original.

(If you've already finished VIDEOVERSE, you'll need to load up a save from near the end (or replay) to unlock this new background.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/1b6f122294101122c6ba84e9d08dc5daef93700d.png[/img]

A [b]HUGE[/b] thank you to everyone who has supported me during VIDEOVERSE's release, whether it's leaving a review, telling a friend or just encouraging me during this busy time, it means the world to me. At the time of writing, VIDEOVERSE is the third in [url=https://opencritic.com/]Open Critic's 2023 Hall of Fame[/url] – Something I [b]NEVER[/b] thought would happen! It's also received ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ from The Guardian, "Bestest Bests" from Rock Paper Shotgun and 8/10 from EDGE Magazine. For such a small, self-published indie game, this is incredible to see and I'm simply overwhelmed right now, haha! 

[b]Thank you all![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/0e256ac7eaaa88f46579a1fc180fb2deeb390eea.png[/img]

notes.title: Kinmoku's second game ‘VIDEOVERSE’ out now!
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that VIDEOVERSE has launched today as part of Steam’s Visual Novel Fest for PC, Mac and Linux. VIDEOVERSE has been several years in the making, so it's a little surreal to see it finally out in the wild, but I hope you find it worth your wait! To celebrate, enjoy a 10% launch discount, available from now until Monday 14th August.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/d9f1bfd929907bf2e8ab90d75e01eec262100ac0.png[/img]

For those that don't know, VIDEOVERSE is a narrative adventure game about love and friendship, inspired by Miiverse and MSN Messenger. Players are sent back in time to a fictional video game era, where they can foster friendships, share fan art and browse the lively gaming communities. Will they help Videoverse thrive, or will they get caught up in teenage drama, video game fandoms and corporate conspiracies?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/29dda703ff452650d655bf9759745b07a2776c6d.gif[/img]

Yesterday, Yogscast played VIDEOVERSE as part of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteamsfestival2023]Tiny Teams 2023[/url] – which celebrates games developed by studios with a core team of five or less people. The festival is running until August 10th so there's still time to check out other awesome indie games!

Thanks again to everyone for the continued support and patience over the years. If you download VIDEOVERSE, please leave a review as it helps small indie games so, so much! (Plus I'd love to know what you all think!)

notes.title: One week until release!
notes.content:
With one week to go until VIDEOVERSE launches on August 7th, I thought it would be fun to share the design process of the fictional video game console 'Kinmoku Shark' – where the online social network 'Videoverse' takes place!

To weave the game’s story, I needed a gaming system which would release around the time of the millennium; where video game consoles were beginning to meet [b]The Internet[/b].

[h3][u]Naming the console[/u][/h3]

The name ‘Kinmoku’ is my own developer name. After initially trying a few fake company names, I finally rested on Kinmoku as, because of the evil, corporate connotations later in VIDEOVERSE, it felt best to make fun of myself!

The name ‘Shark’ is inspired by the codename ‘Dolphin’ for GameCube; a name I was fondly attached to as a young teenager. Kinmoku Dolphin even makes an appearance in VIDEOVERSE as a successor to the Shark.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/ce2ac765da8ba739d53fa4a1102780a1a3b07b86.gif[/img]

[h3][u]The history of the Shark[/u][/h3]

Even though it’s a fictional gaming system, the Kinmoku Shark needed realistic specs and a release history. It sports a 1-bit pixel art aesthetic, unusual in our real world gaming timeline, but perhaps not so strange for a portable console focusing less on graphical fidelity and more on functionality. 

Since the internet became popular in homes around 1995, and the Sega Dreamcast (the first console to include a built-in modem for internet support) released in 1998, I decided 1998 would also be a good year for Kinmoku to launch the Shark.

[h3][u]The design[/u][/h3]

Although the Shark was quite modern for its time (being portable with a rechargeable battery), I figured it would connect to the internet via ethernet cable, similar to old-school chunky laptops. However, this was something I only realised a little later, as my earlier designs were a lot like Nintendo handhelds with wi-fi functionality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/2b20ef0690bdfda538517711fc60940a25637529.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/56739483a846775c363695bf58e19c8aff54edf9.png[/img]

To match the 1-bit graphics the system supports, it needed to look older, chunkier and more unique, perhaps even taking 'Shark' literally in its design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/73eee404f0fda463ec5a606ef7b6cbd052210d79.png[/img]

Inspired by the Vectrex, Sega Pico, Commodore and other retro machines, I tried many different designs incorporating a shark fin or sea motif.

The console needed to have a cartridge slot, touchpad, stylus, keyboard, built-in screen, ethernet port and 2 controller ports. It also needed a webcam for the video chats the characters have in-game, but after a few sketches, I realised this should be a peripheral to match the era.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/e51da605762794a1d8a532aca4c43191b4356ab5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/a7cf1f59fabeb1c5fef6398567c3882044c647e0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/01d15f399eb3d37e232673094c81c9bfda1e4e3e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/112410816bfad9d2e2c6442566a861d425f77232.png[/img]

However, I still preferred the simplicity of the original handheld design, so I tried sketching a few variations of it with a webcam peripheral. I was super keen on the cartridge slot being on the front since that somehow feels more retro to me…but, in the end, I didn't think it made much sense alongside the two controller ports, so it got moved to the back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/2f3093a4e12c380fbe4c9b2145f23ac9fdc06669.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/4ed17f7cb9f1c2e96c915273e6c4fc8372c689dd.png[/img]

But what about the controllers? I hadn't given them much thought up until this point (as can be seen by the rough sketches!). Whilst the Shark was designed with built-in buttons and touch screen, more complicated games would be better experienced on controller.

So, should they have a shark/ sea motif, or match the latest console design? I tried a few ideas out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/5e5a3332f496ff2393a2b0dffddc351c1a195e42.png[/img]

The word "chonk" certainly comes up a lot in my sketches! I had a lot of fun designing these, but it was very important for me to remember that the controller would need to be drawn several times throughout the game…so a simpler, more practical design would be a better choice. Plus, it's important for it to feel like a genuine controller, too, which is why I went with the design “console", which was similar in shape to the Kinmoku Shark.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/1e1481c58e42f255286e4005d9dd3fcbd6f3e93f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/8ad356e927221ad21ce65a813bf90b9055cface2.png[/img]

Above is the final design with the chosen controller plugged in. However, I still hadn't come up with a design for webcam peripheral. I was still super keen on using the shark fin motif somewhere in the design…so I subtly added it to the webcam's grip on the back of the console! You can only see it from a side-on angle.

And, with that, the Kinmoku Shark console came into being! You can check it out yourself right now with the [b]VIDEOVERSE demo[/b]...but this will only be playable for one more week until the full game's launch on [b]Monday 7th August at 12pm CEST[/b]. 

I hope you enjoyed reading this design journey of a fiction video game console. I would absolutely love to make a real Kinmoku Shark with a Raspberry Pi one day, though! For now, I'll leave you with this Y2K magazine advert – Would you have bought a Kinmoku Shark in 1998?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/40c75f7eb06ad422d76fac1a3aebdf27b8dd3146.png[/img]

notes.title: VIDEOVERSE launches one month today!
notes.content:
After three years of development, Kinmoku is excited to announce an official release date for VIDEOVERSE – A narrative adventure about love and friendship, inspired by Miiverse! Set to launch [b]Monday 7th August[/b] for PC, Mac and Linux, VIDEOVERSE sends players back in time to a fictional video game era, where players can foster friendships, share fan art and browse the lively gaming communities.

VIDEOVERSE will launch alongside Steam Visual Novel Fest with a 10% launch discount as a thank you to all the loyal fans who have waited years for Kinmoku's next game. Honestly, thank you all so much for the continued support!

To celebrate the release date announcement, there is a new trailer featuring the narrator – Mark Takeshi Ota ([i]LIVE A LIVE, The Great Ace Attorney[/i]) – and new footage showing the eerier side of VIDEOVERSE.

[previewyoutube=L3k_0_KQcDQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The demo is still available to play until launch and was recently recommended by [url=https://kotaku.com/diablo-4-iv-street-fighter-6-final-fantasy-15-xvi-1850549073/slides/6]Kotaku[/url] and [url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/videoverses-first-chapter-is-the-perfect-portrait-of-early-internet-fan-forums]Rock Paper Shotgun[/url]!

If you have any questions about VIDEOVERSE, please leave a comment or contact the developer via the details below:

notes.title: VIDEOVERSE wins the Critics' Choice Award!
notes.content:
Yesterday, the winners of Indie Cup UK 23 were announced and VIDEOVERSE won the Critics' Choice Award!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/1c3505dc9b9e5a6bd935bb1e151fc41824d2eb1c.jpg[/img]

Indie Cup said the following about VIDEOVERSE:

"[Kinmoku]'s early internet period piece tells a timeless story through a very specific time period, and it hit hard with practically all of our jurors."

"Jurors praised its atmosphere, attention to detail and brilliant narrative."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/640547a64fbb5d1b0443cb27c9ebc39944e6687c.jpg[/img]

I still can't believe this incredible news and want to thank everyone who's supported me in making VIDEOVERSE come to life! Congratulations to all the other nominees and season winners, as well!

The demo of VIDEOVERSE is still available to play until release (date TBC really soon!), so please try it out if you haven't already and let me know your thoughts. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: VIDEOVERSE updated demo now available!
notes.content:
VIDEOVERSE's updated demo is now available to download for free! Like the first demo released in March, it contains the first chapter of the game, but with the following changes and improvements:

[list]
[*] More avatar customisation options
[*] Community updates
[*] New chat animations
[*] History log
[*] GUI improvements
[*] Other bug fixes
[/list]
If you played the March build and plan on continuing a save you started, there is a good chance you will run into crashes. I advise you to start afresh with this updated build instead.

I hope you all enjoy the first chapter of VIDEOVERSE and I look forward to hearing any feedback you may have. The demo will be available until the game fully launches - exact release date TBD but some time during Q3 2023!

notes.title: VIDEOVERSE Developer Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I just wanted to give you all a quick update about VIDEOVERSE's development.

Firstly, you may have noticed the updated screenshots on the store page. There are some new additions, showing the avatar creator and silly community drawings, plus the themes have been updated with their own unique graphics. I've also added GIFs to the description, showing more of the drawings and Emmett's favourite game, [i]Feudal Fantasy[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/301b4914cdd26e65d91c63b907111a555a4b64e6.gif[/img]

Feudal Fantasy is the Kinmoku Shark’s most popular JRPG, where Emmett meets other players in its exclusive Videoverse community. It's a clear nod to Final Fantasy, which was the game that lead me to making video games today! VIDEOVERSE is a story about inspiration, dreams and love…and, for me, that all started in the fan forums and chat rooms of my favourite video games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/96b3e3d822b93c54a6a66a50d86b1e1f4e1d3c63.gif[/img]

VIDEOVERSE itself is about to enter beta testing, meaning it's getting [b]very[/b] close to release. However, the release date is still TBD as I want to ensure there are no bugs or glitches when the game launches, so you can all experience the game as it's intended to be.

In the meantime, VIDEOVERSE will be at tomorrow's Indie Live Expo event! You can watch it live on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t9EL_zK8Ylo]Youtube May 20th 7pm (JST) / 12pm (CEST)[/url]. Also, the next demo of VIDEOVERSE will soon be going live, too. Please keep an eye out for it in the next few weeks.

I thank you all for your patience and support as I finish this project that I started over three years ago. I cannot wait for you all to play it!

notes.title: Thank you for playing the limited time demo!
notes.content:
I just wanted to say thank you to everyone who downloaded the VIDEOVERSE demo during The Storyteller's Festival. It was a huge success with many new followers and [b]thousands[/b] of downloads, helping VIDEOVERSE find its audience!

The first demo was intended to only be available during the event, but was extended until today as it was also selected to be part of the Women-led Games event from April 7-9. In case you didn't get around to playing the demo yet, there will be another chance soon – with an updated demo – that will launch before the full game's release.

Also, thank you to everyone who sent me their thoughts and feedback about the demo. I received some great suggestions which I plan to implement next. VIDEOVERSE is now entering the final stages of development, so if you still have some feedback or thoughts on what you played, it's not too late to send them!

I can't wait for you all to experience the full game soon. Until next time!

You may have seen earlier this month that [b]VIDEOVERSE[/b] has been selected to take part in The Storyteller’s Festival, from March 25th to April 1st! The demo of VIDEOVERSE, containing chapter 1, will also be available to download and play during the festival, until April 9th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/876da21b0c29efed831933f3b42683a705e14531.png[/img]

Unfortunately, I am away during The Storyteller's Festival, so I the broadcast will not be live...but, on the plus side, there are now subtitles available for anyone hard of hearing. The broadcast will be available until the end of the festival, too, for anyone who misses it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/0da16b9a7ea86062ec55780e06e97309fc6408cb.png[/img]

I can't wait to hear what you all think of the game! This is the first online demo of VIDEOVERSE, and it's still in development, so it's a great time to hear you feedback – Whether you find a bug, typo or just really, really like it, I'd love to know!

Also, there's new banner artwork on the store page featuring the [b][i]Kinmoku Shark gaming system[/i][/b]! I'm really pleased with how it looks – I think it really shows off the game well – but, more importantly, a release window of "Q3 2023" has also appeared – [b]Ooooh![/b] So, not long to wait until you can play the full game for yourself!

notes.title: VIDEOVERSE is taking part in The Storyteller’s Festival
notes.content:
Hello! I’m excited to announce that [b]VIDEOVERSE[/b] has been selected to take part in [b]The Storyteller’s Festival, from March 25th to April 1st[/b]. A free demo, containing chapter 1 of the game, will be available to download and experience during the event – I can’t wait for you all to play it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/876da21b0c29efed831933f3b42683a705e14531.png[/img]

The VIDEOVERSE store page has also been updated with a gameplay trailer, new screenshots, description and GIFs, which divulge more information about what you do in the game. I hope you like what you see and I’d love to know your thoughts.

As for VIDEOVERSE itself, I’m happy to tell you that the following accessibility features have been added to the game:

[list]
[*] Closed captions
[*] Clear font option 
[*] A tip button, which can be used to conveniently find your solution without needing to quit the game and hunt online for one
[/list]

Plus, I’ve recently added more chat animations, characters and side quests so Videoverse continues to feel like a living, breathing community!

I'll soon be announcing the release date for the full game so stay tuned! Until then, please try out the demo available later this month on [b]March 25th[/b]. There will also be a broadcast event about VIDEOVERSE on [b]March 26th at 5:00 PM GMT/ 9:00 AM PST.[/b]

notes.title: Day of the Devs - 10th Anniversary
notes.content:

VIDEOVERSE has been selected to be part of Day of the Devs 10th Anniversary on November 5th in San Francisco…and I’ll be there in-person, showing the first playable demo of the game!

The event is at The Midway and general admission starts at 3pm (PT). More information and ticket reservations can be found [url=https://www.eventbrite.com/e/day-of-the-devs-10th-anniversary-in-person-celebration-tickets-425356511777]here.[/url]

If you're unable to make it in person, there is also a digital event on November 3rd at 10am (PT) which will be on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/thegameawards]The Game Awards Twitch channel[/url], where you can see the games in the showcase!

I hope you’ll join us all in the celebrations! :)

notes.title: Announcing Kinmoku's second game: VIDEOVERSE
notes.content:
VIDEOVERSE is narrative adventure game about love and friendship, inspired by Miiverse, and will be releasing soon on PC, Mac and Linux. It's set in the days of the early internet and fan forums, and is named after the fictional online social network in which it is based (Videoverse). As the player spends time in Videoverse, they'll discover people in need, form friendships and help make the online community warm and welcoming. Some friends in particular are going through difficult times, and the game helps prepare the player navigate heavy topics. However, there are plenty of fun and silly moments to enjoy throughout the game as well (it is inspired by Miiverse, after all!).

VIDEOVERSE can be enjoyed in around 6 hours, but there are optional side stories and various narrative branches. You can also personalise your experience by customising your Videoverse avatar, setting your personal quote and choosing a favourite theme.

The music is composed by Clark Aboud (Slay the Spire, Kind Words), who's created a beautifully chill, retro-inspired soundtrack for the fictional video game console, the "Kinmoku Shark". Additionally, VIDEOVERSE will feature voice acting, though more details on this will be announced in future posts.

You can find out more about VIDEOVERSE by checking out its [url=http://gamesbykinmoku.epizy.com/videoverse/]home page[/url], or subscribing to [url=https://gamesbykinmoku.us3.list-manage.com/subscribe/post?u=9207b9359f63f6aab834705fe&id=96a52853fd]Games by Kinmoku newsletter[/url].

Thanks again to all the fans who have stayed patient throughout the years to hear more about Kinmoku's next project! :)
